blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative eight minus four times negative one, all over two minus six.
The top and the bottom each work like parentheses. On top, multiplication first. Four times negative one is negative four.
Now subtract. On top, negative eight minus negative four is negative four. On the bottom, two minus six is negative four.
Finally, divide. Negative four divided by negative four is one, since a negative divided by a negative is positive.
Watch out for these traps. If you subtract before multiplying on top, you get negative three. If you ignore the fraction bar, you get negative twelve.
